name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.165: A dry run no longer leaves state behind that changes the next real run.
    It writes no registry rows, spends no retry or id-resolution budget, starts no refetch
    clock and clears nothing — and the download queue keeps every reported item as open.
    Until now each of those sat before the dry run's own exit and ran anyway, so a single
    dry run could hide work for a full refetch interval or empty the queue of everything
    it had just described.
